summary: Iteration 5 frontend-only verification of Pro Photo Sorter (Batch Rename, Comparison View, Face-Detection Auto-Rate, Contact Sheet PDF). Runtime Playwright checks on https://photo-sorter-30.preview.emergentagent.com confirmed: app loads with 0 console/page errors; all new toolbar controls render (open-editor, compare-1/2/3 segmented control, auto-rate-btn, open-rename, open-contact, open-category-manager, open-settings, show-help); all image-dependent buttons correctly disabled with no folder open; compare-1 carries the active highlight (bg-primary-earth) by default; Escape closes Settings, Categories and Help modals; SettingsModal Cancel bugfix (iteration-2) still holds (template value unchanged after edit+cancel+reopen). Static verification passed for rename.js (renderRenameTemplate, RENAME_PRESETS, RENAME_TOKENS), focusScore.js (computeFocusScore, detectFaces, computeAutoRating, isFaceApiAvailable), contactSheet.js (buildContactSheet), BatchRenameModal.jsx, ContactSheetModal.jsx, ComparisonView.jsx, jspdf@2.5.2 in package.json and node_modules, App.js batchAutoRate/batchAutoEnhance, Escape branches for showRename/showContact, and storage.js default schema (categories, settings, ratings, looks). Rename/Contact/Auto-Rate/Compare runtime flows could not be exercised (File System Access directory picker cannot be automated) - reviewed by source inspection only.

integration_issues.issue: Ratings are keyed by `${sourcePath}/${img.name}` in localStorage. runRename() renames files in place and onDone() re-lists the directory, but no rating-key remapping is done, so all star ratings for renamed photos are silently lost (and {stars} tokens on a re-run would read 0).

BatchRenameModal preview loop only parses EXIF for the first 8 images (`if (i < 8)`); every image at index >= 8 gets exifDate = null and renderRenameTemplate falls back to today's date. Because runRename() consumes these same previews, {date} templates write today's date instead of the real capture date for all photos after the 8th - a data-correctness bug, not just a preview limitation.

runRename() copies each source to a __pps_tmp_* file and immediately removeEntry()s the original before phase 2 renames temps to final names. If the tab is closed / an error occurs between the two phases, the user's originals are already deleted and only __pps_tmp_* files remain (no recovery path). Consider writing the final name first and deleting the original only after a successful write.

ContactSheetModal builds `entries` by calling img.handle.getFile() for every image up-front without awaiting/catching, so for large filmstrips all file promises are created eagerly and a rejected promise (deleted/moved file) surfaces as an unhandled rejection before buildContactSheet awaits it. Wrap in a lazy accessor (() => handle.getFile()) or per-entry catch.

issues: When compareMode > 1 the IconOverlay, nav-prev/nav-next buttons and the rating-overlay are not rendered at all, so a user in compare mode loses drag-drop tagging, arrow navigation buttons and star rating UI with no on-screen hint that they must return to x1. Recommend keeping at least nav buttons + rating overlay, or showing an explanatory badge.
ComparisonView renders fewer panes than requested when images.length < panes without any indication (e.g. x3 selected with 2 images silently shows 2 panes).

action_items: Remap rating keys (old path -> new path) after Batch Rename so star ratings survive renaming.
Parse EXIF for all images (or lazily at rename time) instead of only the first 8, otherwise {date} renames are wrong for photos 9+.
Make Batch Rename crash-safe: write final name before deleting the original, or clean up orphan __pps_tmp_* files on next folder load.
Make ContactSheetModal entries lazy / add per-file catch to avoid unhandled promise rejections on missing files.
Consider retaining rating overlay + nav buttons in comparison mode (currently hidden with no user hint).
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 1119 lines - well past the 700-line guideline. Extract the toolbar, keyboard-shortcut effect and modal wiring into separate modules.

Keyboard handler returns early when activeElement is an input/textarea/select; inside BatchRenameModal and ContactSheetModal the template/title input is focused by default, so Escape will NOT close those modals while typing. Either handle Escape locally in each modal (onKeyDown) or allow Escape through the input guard.
compareMode is not reset to 1 when the source folder is closed/changed; state persists while the compare buttons are disabled, which can surprise the user on the next folder open.
focusScore.computeFocusScore normalization constants (log10 2.0..3.6) are empirical magic numbers - move to named constants and document, since they directly drive user-visible star ratings.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of automatable checks passed (11/11 runtime + static assertions)

seed_data_creation: None. No backend/DB involvement; app is fully client-side with localStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All runtime-automatable iteration-5 checks pass: toolbar testids (open-editor, compare-1/2/3, auto-rate-btn, open-rename, open-contact, open-category-manager, open-settings, show-help - NOTE the help button testid is 'show-help', not 'open-help'), disabled states with no folder, compare-1 active highlight, Escape on settings-modal/category-manager/help-modal, settings-cancel no-persist bugfix. Modals are plain divs (no role="dialog"); use their data-testid (settings-modal, category-manager, help-modal, batch-rename-modal, contact-sheet-modal). Reported issues are all business-logic/UX level (rating key remap after rename, EXIF only for first 8 images, non-atomic rename, eager getFile promises, hidden controls in compare mode); no code was modified by this agent. Pre-existing eslint warning: App.js line 103 appliedIcons/useMemo exhaustive-deps.
rca_of_the_issue: Rating loss after rename: ratings are stored keyed on file path (`${sourcePath}/${name}`); BatchRenameModal.runRename changes the file names but onDone only re-lists the directory - nothing rewrites the ratings map, so the old keys become orphaned and the renamed files show 0 stars. EXIF bug: the `if (i < 8)` guard in the preview effect was intended to limit expensive exifr parsing for display, but previews are also the source of truth used by runRename, so the today's-date fallback leaks into the actual written filenames.
